adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#remove_member the diff shows membership removal is done via `group.users.delete(user_id)` and then `group.save` (which likely doesn’t persist anything on `groups` itself). This bypasses any encapsulated membership-removal logic that previously went through `group.remove(user)` (see removed `update_patch` path), so if `Group#remove` / join-model callbacks perform side effects (counter updates, auditing, etc.), they will now be skipped. The added spec only asserts `group.users.count` and would not catch missed side effects. However, the specific claim about a stale `user_count` corrupting pagination totals is not directly verifiable from the diff because pagination totals in `GroupsController#members` are computed via `group.users.count` each request.
